name: Fenspiride

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market in European Union, first in 2019 — for heart harm

summary: Fenspiride was pulled from the market in the European Union starting in 2019 due to heart harm [3]. A small computer model, rather than tests on human beings, evaluated the drug's potential risks [M]. This computer model gave the drug a low risk score of 38 for the liver, but a high risk score of 90 for the heart [M].
